correctness.rationale: The nonnegative signless-Laplacian spectrum gives a unique root in (0,1]. Trace plus vertex/edge transitivity yields exact edge and vertex covariance diagonal identities, hence containment and all facet contacts. Explicit positive weights p=dt/(1+dt), q=d/(2(1+dt)) satisfy both John vector and matrix moment identities, proving global optimality and uniqueness. Singular bipartite signless Laplacians are accounted for by edge-space zero eigenvalues. Product spectra give exact determinant, direct reduction gives K_{d,d} quadratic, and a uniform Riemann-sum limit gives the cycle golden ratio. Extracted checker passed 40 graph cases with 1,176 contacts; finite examples are not proof.

General orbit-polar results do not state the present two-facet-orbit free-center formula. Own complete-graph formula is a strict special case and is not counted as new.
